title: PulseTypeRegistry
description: Authoritative registry of all 38 valid Pulse types in RYU AI, organized by namespace.

types.description: Emitted when a new Space is instantiated.
Emitted when an existing Space is restored from checkpoint.
Emitted when a Space finishes execution or reaches its goal.
Emitted when a Space's artifacts and timeline are archived.
Emitted when Space spend exhausts or breaches budget limits.
Emitted when a Command is converted into a structured Goal Spec.
Emitted when an initial versioned Task Graph is planned.
Emitted when a plan delta modification is proposed.
Emitted when a concurrent replan loses CAS commit to a winning delta.
Emitted when a Task Graph node is assigned to an agent or worker.
Emitted when an assigned task begins execution.
Emitted when a task finishes successfully with an artifact reference.
Emitted when a task encounters a transient or terminal failure.
Emitted when a transient task failure triggers a retry attempt.
Emitted when a worker invokes an underlying tool capability.
Emitted when a tool invocation completes successfully.
Emitted when a tool invocation fails.
Emitted when the orchestrator applies a plan delta revision.
Emitted when the orchestrator reassigns a task between execution roles.
Emitted when a worker or agent requests a leased resource.
Emitted when the Resource Manager grants a lease on a resource.
Emitted when a resource request is rejected.
Emitted when a held resource lease is relinquished.
Emitted when a resource request contends for an existing lease and is queued.
Emitted when a requester exceeds rate quotas and requests are queued; backpressure, not failure.
Emitted when a capability grant on a remote node runtime is issued.
Emitted when an active node capability grant is revoked.
Emitted when a node runtime misses heartbeats beyond TTL.
Emitted when an offline node reconnects and re-establishes its lease.
Emitted when untrusted external content enters the pulse stream.
Emitted when human approval clears taint forward for a correlation_id.
Emitted when an authorized approver approves a high-risk capability grant.
Emitted when a capability grant request is denied.
Emitted when Space-local knowledge is proposed for global promotion.
Emitted when promotion to global knowledge is approved.
Emitted when promotion to global knowledge is rejected by validator or approver.
Emitted when memory state (task, agent, or space scope) is updated.
Emitted when structured experience including counterfactual is stored.
